posts.title: AI Coding: A Force Multiplier, Not a Replacement
posts.description: Over the past year, AI-assisted coding has transformed from an experimental novelty into an essential tool in my development workflow. I’m using Zed Editor with Claude Code, and the results have been remarkable. But let me be clear from the start: AI hasn’t replaced me as a software engineer. Instead, it’s become a powerful force multiplier that amplifies my capabilities.
